subject.title: feat(models): make per-agent model allowlist explicit; aliases/defaults no longer restrict

question: Should the migration preserve legacy default-model restrictions from resolved `$include` configuration before this new marker-based policy contract is accepted?
rationale: The intended policy split is reasonable, but silently dropping an existing override restriction is a security-sensitive upgrade behavior and requires maintainer acceptance of the source-preserving migration boundary.

options.title: Repair include-aware migration
options.body: Use the resolved configuration to derive legacy refs while writing only the narrow policy/marker change into the authored config, with a regression test.

options.title: Pause the new policy contract
options.body: Defer the feature until the configuration include/migration ownership boundary has a reviewed design.

recommendation.title: Repair include-aware migration
recommendation.body: Use the resolved configuration to derive legacy refs while writing only the narrow policy/marker change into the authored config, with a regression test.
